description: Defines the Http2DecoderAdapter class which adapts the SpdyFramer interface to use Http2FrameDecoder, including enums for states and errors, callback setters, process input method, and internal state management. Also includes interfaces for frame and extension visitors for handling HTTP/2 frames and headers.
external_methods: size_t ProcessInput(const char* data, size_t len)

classes.name: Http2DecoderAdapter
classes.description: A class that adapts SpdyFramer interface to use Http2FrameDecoder, managing frame decoding states, errors, and callbacks for HTTP/2 frames.

classes.name: SpdyFramerVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling callbacks during frame decoding, including errors, headers, data, and control frames.

classes.name: ExtensionVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling non-standard settings and frames during decoding.

methods.name: set_visitor
methods.description: Sets the callback visitor for frame events.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Decodes a chunk of encoded HTTP/2 data, returning the number of bytes consumed.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current state of the decoder.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the decoder is in an error state.

methods.name: StopProcessing
methods.description: Indicates that the visitor no longer wishes to receive events.

methods.name: SetMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed size for frame payloads.
